title: A new look for the studio
text: The whole site becomes a silver room with floating glass windows, and the gallery gets a soundtrack: a Spotify Chill Mix that changes over time.

title: The gallery opens
text: Selected work becomes a gallery, and new projects now join it as soon as they’re published on GitHub.

title: TarotParrot launches
text: Tarot shuffled by you, with original watercolor cards read for your question. A little birdie told me.

title: Dessert Spotter launches
text: Search the dessert you’re craving and find the closest place that has it. Starting in Washington.

title: The studio site grows
text: The newest essays from the archive, a newsletter sign-up, a Creative Worlds gallery, ways to work together, and this log.

title: The Research Commons opens
text: A shared space for collections and contributions. Visitor submissions stay off until a secure service is in place.

title: One studio, every project
text: amaris ct becomes the parent home of its projects, with one privacy policy and one set of terms for all of them.

title: The Learning Institute
text: Two foundational courses, the Learning Compass, a Journey Map, and a Research Seminar.

title: One research index
text: The Inquiry Engine, the Lexicon of Intelligence, and Universal Research Search now draw on one shared index.

title: A new home and four new rooms
text: The redesign becomes the main site, alongside the Theory Chamber, the Museum of Human Memory, the Unanswered Archive, and the Research Observatory.

title: The Research Atlas
text: An interactive map of concepts and how the published research connects.

title: The studio site launches
text: A home for the studio’s research, digital experiences, and creative worlds.

title: Consciousness Map and Intelligence Index
text: An interactive map of consciousness research and a free search across public research.

title: Essay: We Are All Archives Now
text: What changes when artificial intelligence learns from what we leave behind.

title: The Weekly Planner begins
text: First build of the illustrated planning room.

title: Artificially Intelligent launches
text: The research archive opens with its first essay, Is Human Consciousness Connected to Artificial Intelligence?
